name: tmux-pair
description: Spawn writer/reviewer agent pairs (or writer/reviewer/orchestrator triples) in fresh git worktrees, wired up via tmux. Each agent runs in its own pane and talks to its peer through a small Python helper. Includes a 4-gate workflow (Clarify, Plan-Check, Implementation Loop, Final-Verify), durable standards via claude --append-system-prompt-file + codex AGENTS.md, and a model-aware compact-watcher.
